Name: Custom Volcano Dungeon
Author: po0pfart
Description:
This mod aims to make volcano dungeon run manageable and more rewarding. You can customize the following:

[list]
[*]How often normal stone turns into ore stones
[*]How often normal stone turns into cinder shard stone
[*]How often normal stone turns into gemstone
[*]How often normal stone turns into mystic stone
[*]How often dragon tooth spawns
[*]How many monster appear on each floor
[*]How often treasure chest spawns
[*]How often normal chest is replaced by rare chest
[/list]Check out my other QoL mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/po0pfart/mods]po0pfart's Mods[/url]

Downloads.Description: Lets you configure how often resource stones, monsters and chests spawn.
